programs.description: When Jayanthi's husband, Ramesh, who is accused in a gold smuggling case, goes missing, she comes to Kochi to find him. In her quest to locate him, she comes across Raju, a taxi driver.
ACP Antony Moses has managed to track down his friend's killer when he meets with an accident resulting in partial memory loss. Soon, he is reassigned to investigate the murder and find the culprit.
Fed up with the fast-paced city life, Ramdas and his wife decide to move to a quiet bungalow on the outskirts of the city. However, some strange happenings in the surrounding put their lives at risk.
Vimala and her three sisters run a theatre called Maharaja Talkies. They get in trouble when Pappachan, a rich man, forces Vimala to shut down the theatre.
Ryan Philip is a mischievous 8-year-old who struggles with math and his strict teacher Pappan. However, everything changes when he discovers a magical pen that helps him solve all his problems.
A group of college friends meet after many years for a class reunion. However, due to some unexpected turn of events, several dark secrets are revealed, which changes their lives.
Pullu Giri is trying to live a peaceful life and forget his ruffian past. Following an incident, he gets dragged into the affairs of some local gangs.
The disastrous floods in Kerala in 2018 bring about fatal implications for every individual. Later, people from different backgrounds cooperate to weather the disaster.
Shaji Pappan and his team participate in a tug-of-war tournament to overcome their financial crisis. However, fate entangles them in a counterfeiting deal.
Vinod, a quarrelsome young man, moves into his sister's house in a village to get his life in order. There, he happens to meet Anupama and falls in love with her.

An orphan's simplistic life changes overnight after she marries a wealthy landowner. However, tragedy strikes after the landowner is found dead and the orphan is arrested for the murder.

When a powerful explosion occurs at the Vilayam beach seconds after Chief Minister Madhavan leaves the venue, Police Officer Rishikesh is tasked with the investigation to find the truth behind the blast.
Josy is an unemployed young man who never acts responsibly. His life changes when his beloved mother dies in a fatal accident and his long-lost father returns home.
When his father dies, Chandran is forced to go abroad to earn money to pay his father's dues. On a holiday to India, he meets his childhood lover and hopes to rekindle the relationship.
Lal Krishna, an eccentric criminal lawyer, defends the woman accused of Chinthamani's murder. However, he learns that there is more to the story and decides to dispense justice in his own way.
Menon buys land for his five-star hotel and asks his trusted employee, Sreedharan Unnithan, to take its charge. Years later, Unnithan gets Menon imprisoned in a fake case and Kunjumon helps him.
Stephen Nedumpally, a mystifying leader of the crime world, must lead a double life to protect his world by rekindling some old memories.
After learning that his father was brutally killed by Bhallaladeva, Mahendra Baahubali raises an army to defeat him and release his mother from the former's captivity.
Viju, a motivational speaker, is hired to be the face of a religious scam for which he undergoes rigorous training. As his popularity grows, he sinks into the depths of darkness and delusion.

Priya is furious to learn that her alcoholic husband, Sathyanadhan, is in love with Neena. Things deteriorate further after she files for divorce and her family takes some foolish steps.
Friends Chacko and Hari are fed up with their employer and plan a trip to Goa. Their trip turns into something unusual when they discover a mysterious bag.
Agricultural officer Sachithanandan and his wife Shyama's life changes after the husband's womanising friend Jose visits for a few days.
Sagunan always underestimates his wife and never appreciates her work. However, due to an unexpected turn of events, he ends up realising the value of not only his wife, but women in general.
Love knocks on the door of Rambo, an unlucky man. However, a dilemma arises when he develops feelings for two women at the same time.
Kunjava and his mate welcome a tail-wagging friend called Neymar, only to find their lives thrown into complete disarray.
After spending two sleepless nights taking care of his sick daughter, a person with hearing and speech disability falls asleep in a metro. A passenger photographs him and shares it online.
A thief robs the automated teller machines of the Imperial Bank of India. Worried about the safety of the bank, the managing director decides to hire a private detective to solve the case.
When her spouse, Manu, gets kidnapped, Indu approaches her confidante Sagar for succour. Soon, Sagar goes to Goa to save Manu and gets entangled in a lethal game.

Gopan, a tourist guide, issues a statement against his rival, Kuriyachan, regarding a human trafficking case. However, Kuriyachan seeks revenge against Gopan.
Seelabhati along with her mother visits a remote village where she starts working as a computer teacher. When some students mysteriously disappear, the villagers start blaming her educational course.
When two friends run into David, an IPS official, they reveal an unfortunate event that changed their lives. David helps them get out of the mess, but he is not what he claims to be.
Rini, the right-hand of a corrupt businessman, begins to become greedy for money. He asks his boss to help him settle down with a jewellery shop, but fate has other plans for him.
Lallu, a happy-go-lucky person who loves to hang out with his friends, is in pursuit of true love. One day, he finds a photo of a missing woman, Diya, in the newspaper and feels a spark.
The exiled prince Raghav embarks on a perilous journey to rescue his wife, Janaki, from the clutches of the demon king Lankesh. He must gather an army to wage an epic battle against evil forces.
Rajesh, a gold dealer, lends some gold jewelry for a village wedding, unaware of the betrayal ahead. However, the bride's husband plans to keep the gold and kill Rajesh.
A small village seeks help from a man with extraordinary force to protect them against man-eating tigers and the drug mafia.
Following a tycoon's discovery of a rare oil reserve, a compassionate beggar gets trapped in the dangerous mechanisms of his rapacious scheme.

A young mobile phone shop owner's life takes a turn after he gets his hands on a tapping app. Meanwhile, his heart finds comfort in the presence of a beautiful woman waiting at a bus stand nearby.
Sadasivan comes across a house where the owner, Kumaran, has committed suicide to protect his wife, Soumini. However, what is even stranger is that a man who is visually challenged is always around.

Apoorvan, a school dropout, aspires to become a renowned scientist and tries various experiments. While his friends Babumon and Chopra help him, the three often land in trouble due to their behaviour.
Oliver Twist, a father yearning to bond with his sons, desperately comes up with ideas to forge a close connection with them.
Vijay Govind, a young lecturer in a college, wishes to get married at the earliest. He tries to woo Geetha, an independent and a level-headed woman, who is not easy to convince.
Gopalakrishnan meets Veena while trying to smuggle a stolen necklace. Later, he accompanies Veena on her mission to unite with her lover.
Led by an ambitious captain, India charges into the 1983 Cricket World Cup final as the underdog to claim a historic victory against defending champion West Indies.
Having been rejected once, Sachin, a young man, falls for Reenu, a girl he meets during a wedding and sets out to win her over.
During the Mamangam fair, a new legend is born when a 12-year-old boy, Chandroth Valiya Panikkar, survives a battle with the mighty army of Zamorin.

Sam Alex, a police officer, resorts to alcohol to ease the pain of his family's death. However, his life turns around when he is called to investigate a series of murders showing a similar pattern.
Siddharth often has problems with his wife Anjali owing to his short temper. Things take an unexpected turn when they get involved with a gangster.
A man proposes to his close friend on the night before her wedding. However, he incurs the wrath of her older brothers when he elopes with her.

Unni and Ashwathy's life takes a turn after he accidentally kills her cousin in a tussle. After spending time in prison, he moves to Chennai with his family, hoping to start a fresh chapter, but his past catches up with him.
Old Kochu Thresia's family is irked by her childlike behaviour and does not comply with her bizarre demands. She finds an unusual friend in Reji, a down-to-earth young man, who fulfils her demands.
When the daughter of a minister gets kidnapped, Christy is called upon to rescue her. Although he manages to save her, he himself gets embroiled in the kidnapper's murder.
A group of seven men attempt to conduct a seance, only to find themselves in a predicament when a spirit begins to answer their queries.
Prince remains a bachelor, despite his good qualities, However, chaos follows when he marries a woman who is his polar opposite.
Padmanabhan, a man who joins political rallies to make money, gets into trouble when he is elected mayor of Thiruvananthapuram and is forced to fight corruption in the city.

Vijay's life takes an unexpected turn when he falls for Merin. However, he is already betrothed to Pavithra, the daughter of an affluent man.

The lives of a taxi driver, a man travelling to Kerala and a public prosecutor intertwine with each other as they seek monetary aid and justice.

Premachandran, a carpenter, rescues Kanmani, an ill-treated maid, and takes her into his care. However, to escape from her former abusers, Kanmani dresses up as a boy and joins the team of carpenters.
Saraswathiyamma is the head of a noble family that treats her servant Krishnan as one of her own sons. When her relatives conspire to sell her house, she and Krishnan set out to save it.
Jayabharathi, an ambitious girl, strives to complete her education. However, when her parents marry her off, she attempts to carve an identity for herself.
Seasoned cop Abraham Ozler delves into an enigmatic cold case, sparking a relentless pursuit of a cunning serial killer.
Three cousins, Divya, Krishnan and Arjuna, share a close bond and decide to move to Bangalore to fulfil their childhood dreams. There, they face challenges that will change their lives forever.
The students of two schools consider each other as rivals and constantly keep fighting. However, Professor John tries to guide the students towards the right path.

David and Sara's marriage fails due to an unexpected turn of events. Years later, they continue to love one another and also strive to prove Sara's sister's innocence in a murder case.

The villagers of Vellimala force the government to build a dam in their village. However, when the dam becomes unsafe, the government decides to destroy it, leading to violent protests by the villagers.
In 1796, Kerala Varma, king of Pazhassi, leaves his kingdom due to the East India Company and seeks refuge in the Wayanad forests. He then uses guerrilla warfare tactics against his enemies.
Years after a young woman, Mythili, is murdered in a supposedly haunted mansion, Sethurama Iyer, a CBI officer, decides to find the culprit and solve the mystery.
An aspiring policeman embarks on an unauthorised mission to investigate a devious scientist. However, he confronts various challenges when his actions are exposed.
A folk singer in 17th-century Kerala flees slavery and discovers a mansion. Inside, he encounters an enigmatic cook and a powerful master, setting in motion a chain of events that changes his life.
Michael, the third son of the Anjootti family in Kochi, takes over the business. Moreover, a few house members join with foes to clamp down on him.
Determined to catch a notorious criminal, a police officer and his team undergoes several challenges as they scale the lengths of the country.
